ships.name: Phoenician Merchantman (Gaulos / Round Ship)
ships.nativeName: سفينة غاولوس التجارية الفينيقية (سفينة الخيل / هيبوس)
ships.historicalPeriod: Late Bronze Age to Persian Era (c. 1400 – 400 BCE)
hullFeatures: Symmetrical convex hull with high curved stem and stern
Carved horse head figurehead (hippos) on the prow
Single central cedar mast with broad square linen sail
Deep cargo hold fitted with amphora racks and timber lashings
ships.constructionMethod: Shell-first mortise-and-tenon jointing with internal ribbing inserted afterward

ships.name: Punic War Galley (Trireme / Quinquereme)
ships.role: Naval Defense, Ramming Warfare, and Fleet Superiority
hullFeatures: Long slender waterline optimized for high-speed ramming acceleration
Bronze-sheathed underwater rostrum (ram) fitted directly to the keel
Outrigger frames (parexeiresia) supporting upper tier oar tholes
Painted Phoenician carpenter letters on timbers for prefabricated mass assembly
Protective lead sheathing on underwater hull to deter marine shipworm (*Teredo navalis*)
ships.constructionMethod: Prefabricated modular components verified by the Marsala shipwreck excavation
